base_url.description: Home Assistant base URL (e.g. https://homeassistant.local:8123). The adapter appends /api/states and /api/services/<domain>/<service>.

access_token_ref.description: 1Password reference to the long-lived access token (op://<vault>/<item>/<field>). NEVER a raw secret per ADMINISTRATEME_BUILD.md §L1.

poll_interval_s.description: In-process Cat-C inbound state-poll cadence in seconds. Defaults to 60s; pack.yaml's cron is a heartbeat the supervisor uses to detect a wedged adapter.

reminder_context_signals.description: Explicit allowlist of Home Assistant entities that may become expiring, private reminder-context facts for one member.

sensitivity_floor.description: Adapter sensitivity floor. Config may RAISE the floor but cannot LOWER it below the hardcoded class default per SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md §6 invariant 10.
